title: The Dark Flotilla's Beacon
logline: A deep-belt scrapper recovers the flight beacon of an ore convoy presumed lost twenty years ago, discovering that the crew did not perish but went dark on purpose to flee an indentured penal mining contract.

roles.description: Skipper of a rust-eaten asteroid salvage tug; weathered, broke, and dreaming of one clean score.
Former captain of the runaway ore freighter who built a hidden free settlement in the radiation belt.
Enforcement accountant for the mining corporation that claims the salvage rights and penal bonds.
A heavy private security frigate tasked with liquidating runaway debtor assets.
A high-interference hollowed asteroid where the runaway convoy lives off the grid.
A ramshackle outer outpost where independent salvage crews sell recovered hull scrap.
The colossal extraction company that owned the missing ore convoy and its indentured crew.

public_situation: Scrappers celebrating a salvage find in the ion belt report recovering the transponder beacon of a legendary mining convoy lost twenty years ago.
private_truth: The convoy never crashed; the indentured miners faked their loss and powered down their transponders to found a free mining collective deep in the ion storm.

beats.public_change: Corporate bounty notices appear across {role:scrapper_depot_dock} offering rewards for coordinates linked to the lost convoy.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to probe the ion belt coordinates encoded on the beacon to verify if salvageable hull plating remains.
missions.private_fact: He intercepted radio whispers from inside the storm and suspects living miners are guarding the site.

beats.public_change: {role:corporate_enforcer_frigate} deploys picket ships to seal the entrance to the ion storm.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to destroy a corporate drone picket and recover the storm navigation buoy logs before the auditor maps the route.
missions.private_fact: He knows that if the corporation finds the settlement first, every miner's grandchild will be forced into penal servitude.

beats.public_change: {role:convoy_elder} hails from the eye of the storm, offering clean thorium fuel in exchange for the beacon's destruction.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to bring emergency coolant rods into the hidden settlement so their life-support turbines survive the corporate cordon.
missions.private_fact: Three generations of families now live in the asteroid, none of whom possess legal municipal citizenship papers.

beats.public_change: {role:corporate_enforcer_frigate} breaches the outer storm perimeter, training particle beams on the settlement dome.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to disable the corporate frigate's sensor arrays before it transmits the settlement's exact core coordinates.
missions.private_fact: The corporate auditor hails mid-battle offering lifetime mining royalty shares if the pilot paints the colony dome with targeting telemetry.

player_choice.prompt: With the corporate frigate repelled and the hidden colony revealed, the pilot must decide whether to protect the free miners, sell their location to the consortium, or broker a quiet charter.

options.label: Incinerate the beacon and wipe navigation records to let the settlement remain free
Deliver the beacon to the scrapper depot to register the settlement as an independent prospecting claim
Hand the colony coordinates to the corporation for the massive runaway recovery bounty

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot incinerates the beacon and wipes navigation logs.
resolutions.summary: The beacon is destroyed in the star's coronasphere. {role:convoy_elder}'s colony remains hidden, while {role:mining_consortium} closes the twenty-year case as lost.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot destroyed the tracking beacon that would have exposed a hidden colony of escaped penal miners.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the beacon to register the claim.
resolutions.summary: {role:scrapper_captain} files an independent mining charter. The colony gains legal status as a recognized prospecting outpost, paying modest taxes to stay unmolested.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an escaped debtor mining fleet file legal charters to become a recognized freeport.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the colony coordinates to the corporation.
resolutions.summary: {role:corporate_enforcer_frigate} deploys security troops. The colony is seized, its people placed under lifetime debt indentures, while the pilot claims a fortune.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot guided corporate enforcers into an ion storm to reclaim generations of escaped debtor miners.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the defense.
resolutions.summary: Corporate gunboats breach the storm. The asteroid is bombarded into slag while {role:scrapper_captain} flees into the inner system.

loose_threads.detail: The corporate registrar carries twenty-year-old penal indenture dockets whose compound interest exceeds the value of three star systems.
The beacon's broadcast oscillator contains an uncertified quartz crystal cut by a master off-system optical guild.

radio_hooks: Scrappers unearth relic navigation beacon from legendary lost ore convoy.
Mining consortium legal teams issue blanket repossession claims across asteroid belts.
Ion storm turbulence increases across outer planetary perimeters.

voice_direction.scrapper_captain: Gravelly, breathless, and speaks with the perpetual nervous energy of a gambler down to their last chip.
voice_direction.convoy_elder: Deep, deliberate, and carries the quiet authority of someone who built a home from bare rock.
voice_direction.corporation_auditor: Crisp, bureaucratic, and regards human beings purely as defaulting capital balance entries.
